component.name: Matrixus
component.summary: Native Linux Matrix client with MatrixRTC video calls

description.p: Matrixus is a modern, fast, native Linux desktop client for the Matrix communication protocol. It features end-to-end encryption, a GNOME-friendly interface built with GTK4 and Libadwaita, and voice/video calls powered by MatrixRTC and Element Call.

ul.li: Live room list and timeline sync
Video and voice calls via Element Call
Desktop notifications and system theme support

description.p: Initial development release with login, messaging, sync, encryption UI, and MatrixRTC calls.
